Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and the `scripts/review_*` helpers)
B) The orchestrator and poller (`orchestrate*.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify, plan and implement phases (`clarify.yml`, `plan.yml`, `implement.yml`)
D) The documentation only (README, `agents.d/` fragments, `docs/`)
E) Something else: I will name the file, workflow or feature in my answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What does "better" mean for this change?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure; I will link the failing run, issue or PR (RECOMMENDED)
B) Make it faster or cheaper (fewer API calls or model tokens, shorter runtime)
C) Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, retries or `ai:needs-human` escalations)
D) Make it easier to read or understand (documentation or log clarity only, no change in behaviour)
E) Add a new capability; I will describe it in my answer
Q3: How large a change is acceptable?
Choices:
A) One small, surgical change in the single area named in Q1 (RECOMMENDED)
B) Several related changes within that one area
C) A larger change across subsystems (this may be split into an orchestrator project)
